test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Acceptance
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3'** i.e**. 'Rejection'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct **antonym** for **"Acceptance"** is 3)** "Rejection".**
 
• The word** "Acceptance"** in English refers to the action of consenting to receive or undertake something offered. (स्वीकृति)
